---
title: Convergence of sequences
---


:::{#lem-toeplitz}
#### Toeplitz Lemma
  Let $\{a_n\}_{n \ge 0}$ be a sequence of non-negative numbers and $b_n = \sum_{k=0}^n$ is such that $b_n > 0$ for all $n \ge 0$ and $\lim_{n \to ∞} b_n = ∞$. Let $\{x_n\}_{n \ge 0}$ be a sequence of numbers that converge to $x$. Then
  $$
      \lim_{n \to ∞} \frac{1}{b_n} \sum_{k=0}^{n-1} a_k x_k  = x.
  $$
:::

If we take $a_n = 1$, @lem-toeplitz reduces to Ceasaro's mean. 

:::{#lem-kronecker}
#### Kronecker Lemma
  Let $\{b_n\}_{n \ge 0}$ be a seuquence of positive numbers such that $\lim_{n \to ∞} b_n = \infty$.  Let $\{x_n\}_{n \ge 0}$ be a sequence of numbers such that $\sum_{n=0}^{∞} x_n < \infty$. Then,
  $$
    \lim_{n \to ∞} \frac 1{b_n} \sum_{j=1}^n b_j x_j = 0.
  $$
:::
